subject: Request: Help keep demo live — procurement paused
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <sam@healixlabs.com>
Cc: procurement@healixlabs.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Help keep demo live — procurement paused

Hi Samir,

Quick check-in — I heard from your team that the PO is queued in procurement and the legal review is taking longer than expected. Your engineers still have the Redwood sandbox running today but usage is down to the last of the demo credits.

We'd like to avoid any interruption to the scheduled customer demo next week. Would it help if we provisioned a short-term bridging credit to keep the workspace live for ~10 days while procurement finishes the PO? We can scope the credit to the demo project only.

If helpful, please reply with: (1) estimated PO ETA, (2) whether procurement needs a purchase order file or a billing contact, and (3) a rough token/run estimate for the demo (so we size the credit).

I can loop in finance/sales ops to expedite internal approvals.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Samir Patel <sam@healixlabs.com>

Cc: procurement@healixlabs.com
Date: 2026-11-03T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Help keep demo live — procurement paused

Thanks Vanessa — really appreciate you reaching out.

Short answers: our procurement team is the blocker here (they flagged an internal budget re-allocation). I expect a PO + signature within 7–12 business days, but I can't promise. Procurement asked if we could get an invoice or a short-term invoice number to attach to the PO — I pasted them on procurement@healixlabs.com.

For the demo, we expect roughly 30–40k tokens over the next 10 days (two live sessions plus internal testing). If Redwood can provide a scoped credit (demo.redwood + token cap), that would buy us the runway and keep momentum.

Let me know what you need from my side.

Best,
Samir
Head of ML, Healix Labs
sam@healixlabs.com

Subject: Re: Request: Help keep demo live — procurement paused

Samir — thanks for the quick context and the token estimate.

Proposal: Redwood can provision a 10-day, scoped promotional credit capped at 45,000 tokens for the Healix demo project (demo.redwood). Conditions:
- Credit usable only by accounts under healixlab.com and tagged to the demo.redwood workspace.
- Credit expires 10 days after activation.
- We’ll require PO/ETA once it’s available and a primary billing contact for invoicing.

If that works, I'll open the request with sales ops and flag this as a demo-critical runway. Priyom / Dev / Marissa, I’m looping you for approval and the promo terms.

Samir — could procurement confirm whether an interim invoice number would help? If so, we can generate a provisional invoice ID to attach to your PO.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Samir — I’m Priyom, sales ops at Redwood. Vanessa looped me to finalize the bridge credit.

Short version: we can approve a one-time promotional credit of 45,000 tokens scoped to demo.redwood, active immediately and expiring 10 days from activation. I attached the promo terms and a short notice we can provide to procurement (promo-credit-terms.pdf).

Next steps we need from Healix:
1) Confirm acceptance of the scoped credit and agreed expiration.
2) Provide PO ETA and the billing contact person for post-credit invoicing.
3) If procurement requires it, we can issue a provisional invoice ID to attach to your PO — reply here and we’ll generate it right away.

This is a one-off promotional authorization tied to deal DL-2026-4587. Once you confirm, I’ll provision the credit and send a usage report daily to both your billing contact and Vanessa.

Thanks and sorry for the procurement friction — we want to keep your demo live.

—Priyom Das
